deleteConfirmationDialog.title: Really delete data?
deleteConfirmationDialog.description: This will permanently delete your submitted building data from the city server. Your local session and the downloaded PDF report will be kept.
deleteConfirmationDialog.successMessage: Your data has been successfully deleted.

sessionResumeDialog.title: Open Session
sessionResumeDialog.description: You have an open session. Would you like to continue?

startOverConfirmDialog.title: Reset session?
startOverConfirmDialog.description: Are you sure? All saved data for this building will be deleted.

howCalculatedDialog.title: How are these values calculated?
howCalculatedDialog.description: The aim of the calculation is to create a reasonable approximation of the recognized technical standard DIN 18599, incorporating sufficient simplifications to model it with appropriate effort.

buildingWindow.title: Initial Energy Assessment
buildingWindow.subtitle: These results were automatically calculated from public data and model assumptions. In the next step, you can review, supplement, or modify the building data.
buildingWindow.processingTime: Processing takes approximately 5 minutes to complete

addressSearch.infoText: Enter an address or click directly on a building on the map.

mapHelp.tiltViewExplain: Rotate and tilt the view by holding the middle mouse button and dragging.
